title: Disambiguate host-qualified mailbox references from literal display names
outcome: A Host::Name spelling cannot change from ambiguous to wrong-recipient delivery when a literal namesake on another host becomes unavailable.
acceptance: A shared, explicit grammar distinguishes qualified host/name references from literal display aliases across backend and MCP resolvers.
Complete-directory and disconnected-peer controls prevent a literal Host::Name namesake from silently changing alias resolution to another recipient.
Exact participant ids and ordinary complete single-peer name addressing retain their behavior; focused validation and independent review cover the change.
